question: Where does a daily-application install-and-launch catalog sit on the roadmap, and where do its results show up?
allowedInputs: The user request to create a milestone for application compatibility testing and to publish each result on the Tested Applications page
website/src/pages/dashboard/views.tsx Apps and AppDetail, which render applications from the dashboard snapshot
website/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardShell.tsx, which names veros/dashboard/latest.json as the source of the Tested Applications page
differential-tests/syscall-diff/Publish-Dashboard.ps1, which leaves applications empty when the syscall probe runs
website/src/lib/mergeDashboard.ts, which keeps an older applications section when a later snapshot leaves it empty

cursor.prompt: Let's create a milestone to perform this testing. I want to publish the results of each app tested to the tested applications page on the website too.

measuredEffect.note: Milestone 17 is the application catalog. Milestones 18 through 30 are the former 17 through 29, shifted so the numbers follow the work order. Milestones 0 through 16 keep their numbers. No catalog run was performed.
